loaded.how: both holds reached, the clear's summary flush and the index rebuild landed: the daemon's index read is released, the reset's own listing (its read of the cleared log included) runs to its end, published or dropped, and only then the room records' save goes on to the room call's publication

loaded-read-after-answer.how: both holds reached, the clear's summary flush and the index rebuild landed: the room records' save goes on to the room call's publication and the reset answers; once its answer is recorded the daemon's index read is released and the reset's own listing (its read of the cleared log included) runs to its end, before the store refresh may start (resetRefresh in-io: the store refresh fires and starts while the reset awaits its member check, and its listing, answered by the daemon behind the held one, ends after the reset's own listing)

resetReadRace.core: The core has no daemon read to race: a reset publishes its room's row in its room pass, at a fixed point before its answer (native/core/crates/mixdog-core-session/src/session/thread_list.rs:545), and its own listing reads the core's index, not a daemon. Its order is the read-before-publication one, with nothing published after the answer, which Node also produces: the reset's own listing (session-host-lifecycle.ts:401, its daemon read store-summary-catalog.mjs:623-625 from reconcileSessionFile :377) ending before the room call's publication (agent-rooms.ts:387-388), the store refresh inside the reset's I/O (loaded-reset-refresh-in-io). So for the two -read-after-answer cases the replay compares the core's reset, after the answer, whole with loaded-reset-refresh-in-io's same step and part (coreDifferences entries with compareWith), and every other part with the case's own recording.
resetReadRace.daemonRead: store-summary-reader.mjs:305 (listJsonSummariesAsync) → store-summary-catalog.mjs:918 (loadIndexAsync) → :650-653 (stamps of session-summaries.json/.log) → :672/:623-625 (readLogBytesStep of session-summaries.log), then :945 (refreshAsync) → :853 (reconcileSessionFileSteps) → store/session-log-reader.mjs:260 → :141 (readSessionLog of sessions/<room>.log.jsonl); the session.list of the reset's own listing (session-host-lifecycle.ts:401, session-host-catalog.ts:217-238)

holds.clearFlush: observed, not held: the daemon's fs/promises.appendFile of session-summaries.log carrying the room log's row stamped at or after the reset's start (store-summary-index.mjs:529, :619-622), reported over the same connection
holds.daemonRead: benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/lib/daemon-read-hold.cjs, loaded by the daemon: the reset's own listing's first fs/promises.stat of session-summaries.json (the start of its index load) on a stack through listSessionCatalog, armed over the recorder's TCP connection before that listing's session.list is sent (once the session.list calls sent before it have answered)
holds.hostPublication: the room records' save (atomic-file.mjs temp open of agent-rooms.json), the last await before republishCatalog (agent-rooms.ts:387-388)
holds.indexRebuild: benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/lib/daemon-read-hold.cjs: the summary index rebuild worker the reset's clear spawns (store/listing.mjs:378-380 → :111-142, summary-rebuild-worker.mjs) started on a bootstrap that runs it when the recorder releases it, once the clear has reached the summary index; its answer is awaited before the reset's own listing loads the index. Unheld, its base write (store-summary-index.mjs:382-404, which empties the delta log) lands before or after that listing: before, the listing's index rows describe the room log (rows carry incomingTail and compactCount, store-summary-index.mjs:288-290); after, the index has no base and no rows (store-summary-catalog.mjs:742-745), so the listing reads the log and its row has neither (store-summary-catalog.mjs:315-346 rowFromSession, :433-441)
holds.summarySettle: benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/lib/daemon-read-hold.cjs: the reset's own listing is sent only once the daemon's settleSummaryIndexWrites (store-summary-index.mjs:495) has answered after the clear; while an op is queued or in flight the daemon answers a listing from its in-memory rows and reads no index (store/listing.mjs:276)

holds.exchange: the host's read of the room log's session (readItems, session-host.ts:325) from the exchange's rows (agent-room-exchange.ts:186)
holds.memberCheck: the host's control call agentDefinitionPresence on a stack through pruneDeleted (agent-room-membership.ts:67)
holds.namesRefresh: the host's control call listAgents on a stack through refreshNames (agent-room-records.ts:56-59), armed after the first load's own refresh
holds.recordsRead: fs/promises.readFile of agent-rooms.json (readJsonState, atomic-file.mjs:551-553, under loadRecords)
holds.recoveryListing: the daemon call session.list of the listing the recovery's republish starts (its publishCatalogs on a stack through recover)
holds.recoveryPost: the host's control call appendRoomRows on a stack through recover (agent-room-log.ts:61)
holds.updateSave: the room records' save (atomic-file.mjs temp open of agent-rooms.json), agent-rooms.ts:310
